scene: The notebook maps three routes off the windy hilltop.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view along a stone hill terrace. On the far left, a bicycle rickshaw waits beside a lantern. Left of centre, the player in blue flat cap and orange cardigan stands holding a cane, reading the table notebook. Up high, a suspended monorail car hangs from a rail. Far right, a water taxi floats beside pier steps.
shown: a sleek suspended monorail car on an overhead rail up high
a waiting bicycle rickshaw with a canopy parked on the far left
a striped water taxi moored to the stone pier on the far right
